description: Upgrade legacy CSS to modern standards. Scans stylesheets for outdated patterns (floats, clearfix, vendor prefixes, old flexbox syntax, px media queries, @import, !important abuse) and replaces them with modern equivalents. Introduces cascade layers, extracts design tokens, and consolidates redundancy. Use when refactoring CSS, modernizing stylesheets, upgrading legacy code, removing vendor prefixes, or replacing floats with grid/flexbox.
